semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Applied Seals provides essential sealing components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Applied Seals Co. Ltd. manufactures high-quality O-Ring seals and rubber sealing components specifically designed for the semiconductor process industry. Their products are critical for ensuring reliable sealing in various semiconductor applications, adhering to international quality standards.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is based in Taiwan, focusing on manufacturing and continuous improvement in sealing solutions.
